# RhineLabUI scene attribution

Source: https://github.com/LBEILC/RhineLabUI
Commit: d9ecb6c6f7a36e8b522072a0ebbd7691a50550a7
License: MIT, retained alongside these files and in public/licenses/RhineLabUI-MIT.txt.

The real ArchiveScene, long-lens framing, cassette models, lighting, frosted glass, selection/extraction, depth of field and pointer/drag behavior are reused. Local changes replace labels and sample archive metadata with childcare themes, add an illustrated art insert to the selected cassette (superseding the earlier book and letter-block props), fix disposal during asynchronous loading, and adapt asset paths. Four preloaded artwork textures are selected by care theme; returning cards retain their own print, and all textures are disposed on exit. The camera is centered for the full-screen gallery. The React host adds a cancellable 6.5-second back-and-forth slideshow and excludes all original audio, archive documents and application code.
